notes: Product-owned changes on top of the vendored DS Bot runtime. A sync copies upstream, then puts these back on top; nothing here is edited by hand in the vendor tree.

entries.summary: Grok-Bot-style remote desktop tab for the Bot drawer, over the product client's __dshDesktop bridge; delegates to the bridge's renderPane when the product client registered one.
Adds the 电脑操作 (desktop) tab to a 1:1 Bot's drawer and renders DesktopPane in it.
Renders the product's sidebarAddon (the router panel navigation) under the team list.
Accepts a wrapped TeamSidebar in the sidebar.workspaces slot probe, so the product's own wrapper still counts as the DS Bot team surface.
Supports Harness 0.2.2 section-only prompt assembly while retaining the independent hidden-tool execution guard.
Adapts legacy per-Session schedules to the explicit Host-wide Schedule API in Harness 0.2.2 without changing task targets.
